semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides infrared measurement devices that can be utilized in semiconductor manufacturing processes for temperature monitoring.
summary: Shanghai Optris Infrared Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures innovative infrared measurement devices designed for non-contact temperature measurement. Their products, including thermal imagers and industrial infrared sensors, are applicable in various industrial applications, including semiconductor production, to enhance process efficiency and reduce energy consumption.
capabilities: Infrared thermal imagers for non-contact temperature measurement
Fixed industrial infrared sensors for area and point measurements
Continuous monitoring solutions for production processes
